clue.text: Where Prince might shoot vocal backing for Cure piece

indicators.note: the spoken word comes behind, backing up, the remedy word

parts.note: balm is a soothing remedy, a cure
oral means spoken, vocal
a castle is a chess piece, the rook

explanation.surface: A music review: some voice support laid under a track by Prince for The Cure.
explanation.walkthrough: Prince and Cure look like the pop star and the band; Prince is royal and Cure is a remedy. Balmoral is the royal family's Scottish estate, where grouse and deer are shot.
explanation.definitionFit: The royal Scottish residence hosts shooting parties, so a prince might go hunting game there.

clue.text: Translated abroad, skirting around very big words

indicators.note: the reworked letters go round the outside of the abbreviation for very
translated suggests turning the letters of abroad into another form

explanation.surface: Someone working overseas uses grand language while dodging a subject.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Translated' shuffles ABROAD into BRADO, and 'skirting around' puts it round V.
explanation.definitionFit: Boastful, swaggering talk is bluster, the empty big words of someone putting on a show.

clue.text: Animal upset a lot of shops

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the letters upside down, so they read from the bottom up

parts.note: a mall is a collection of many shops

explanation.surface: A creature has knocked over and disturbed a whole row of stores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses A MALL.
explanation.definitionFit: The South American camelid kept for wool and as a pack beast is an animal.

clue.text: Potential parts for child star not including lead part?

indicators.note: the leading letter of the star word is left out

parts.note: a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: A child actor is left out of the starring role in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'child star' reads as a young actor, but the child belongs to the definition and the star is a NOVA.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggs are the cells from which a baby may grow, so they are potential parts of a child.

clue.text: Fish from part of boat docked over vasty extremes

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second
docked means having the tail cut off, so the last letter goes

parts.note: an anchor is part of a boat's equipment

indicators.note: the extremes are the outer letters of vasty

explanation.surface: A catch from a moored boat, brought in over the vast deep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'docked' takes R off ANCHOR, leaving ANCHO; 'extremes' gives VY.
explanation.definitionFit: This small salty oily species of the herring family is a fish.

clue.text: Food sauce enjoyed primarily when drinking bubbly, or vice versa

indicators.note: one piece takes in, swallows, the other
the clue reads as the cheek piece drinking the lively word, and asks for the reverse, so the lively word takes in the rest

parts.note: chipper means cheerful, bubbly
lip means cheek, impudence, sauce

indicators.note: primarily picks out the first letter of enjoyed

explanation.surface: A condiment savoured mainly while sipping champagne, or the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: Read straight, the cheek-plus-E piece would do the drinking; 'or vice versa' flips that so the cheerful word is the container.
explanation.definitionFit: The hot fruit of a capsicum plant is eaten as food and used to spice dishes.

clue.text: Certain amount in bank gets right contractor

indicators.note: the number goes inside the word for bank

parts.note: a shore is the bank of a sea or lake
ten is a certain, specific number

explanation.surface: A sum of money in the bank goes to the correct builder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contractor' looks like a builder, but it is something that contracts, makes shorter.
explanation.definitionFit: Anything that makes things shorter contracts them, so it is a contractor in the literal sense.

clue.text: Like little thing spoken in patois

definitions.text: Like little thing spoken in patois

indicators.note: Caribbean dialect clips little and turns the th of thing into a plain t

parts.note: little clipped to lil, so the phrase heard is lil thing

explanation.surface: Describing a tiny object as it is said in a Jamaican accent.
explanation.walkthrough: Said in Caribbean dialect, 'little thing' comes out without its th sound; the whole clue also describes the sing-song rise and fall of such speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech in patois often has a musical rise and fall, a cadence that sings.

clue.text: Restriction per sodium in 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down, the hot capsicum; this is a variety of it

parts.note: a ban is a restriction
a, as in so much a head, means per
Na is the chemical symbol for sodium

explanation.surface: A health ruling limits how much salt is allowed in the dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'per' gives A as in 'ten pounds a day'.
explanation.definitionFit: The banana pepper is a mild, long yellow variety of the capsicum.

clue.text: Deep South kid holding pan of 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a smoked jalapeño

indicators.note: the child word holds the pan word inside it

parts.note: in the dialect of the American Deep South, child is pronounced and written chile
a pot is a cooking pan

explanation.surface: A youngster in Alabama carries a saucepan of peppers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Deep South here is the southern US, not the country at the bottom of South America whose name the dialect word happens to share.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipotle is a smoke-dried jalapeño, one variety of the capsicum named at 5.

clue.text: Scattered a herb on a 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is one very hot variety

indicators.note: scattered tells you to strew these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A cook sprinkles some herb over a pepper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scattered' rearranges A HERB ON A.
explanation.definitionFit: The habanero is a small, extremely hot lantern-shaped variety of capsicum.

clue.text: Charming address rented, with means to renovate

indicators.note: to renovate is to rebuild, so the letters are reconstructed

explanation.surface: A lovely house is let, and the owner has the funds to do it up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to renovate' rearranges RENTED and MEANS. 'address' looks like a house; it is a manner of speaking to someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Terms of affection such as darling or sweetheart are a fond, charming way of speaking to someone.

clue.text: Gather in nut kernel for bird to eat

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the bird takes the kernel inside, eating it

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

indicators.note: a kernel is the centre, so the middle letter of nut

explanation.surface: Collecting nuts in for a small garden bird to feed on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gather' looks like collecting, but it is the sense of working something out.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather can mean to infer or understand, as does sensing something without reasoning.

clue.text: Pupil's surroundings somehow anodyne after company of writer

indicators.note: the rest comes after the company abbreviation
the reworked letters are what surround the learner letter
somehow says the letters are arranged in some other way

parts.note: L, the learner sign, stands for a pupil

explanation.surface: A school's dull environs follow a writer's firm.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of ANODYNE, NANDOYE, forms the surroundings of L, the learner plate that stands for a pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: The creator of Sherlock Holmes was a Scottish author, a writer of detective fiction.

clue.text: Fugitive muscles onto scam with rosy returns

indicators.note: in a down clue, the muscles go on top of the scam

parts.note: abs are the abdominal muscles
a con is a scam

indicators.note: returns tells you to read the rosy word backwards

parts.note: rosy means red

explanation.surface: A runaway with a toned body, a fraud and a rosy profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' looks like profits; it reverses RED to DER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who runs off to escape the law is a fugitive.

clue.text: Use new cooker to make 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a fierce variety from north-east India

parts.note: an Aga is a large iron range cooker, a British kitchen fixture

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: cook with the new stove to prepare peppers.
explanation.walkthrough: An AGA is a heavy cast-iron range cooker common in British country kitchens.
explanation.definitionFit: The Naga, or Naga Viper, is one of the hottest varieties of capsicum.

clue.text: Short ode to cat is artistic work

indicators.note: short means cut off before the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a poem to a cat would begin O Puss, addressing the pet

explanation.surface: A brief poem praising a cat counts as a piece of art.
explanation.walkthrough: An ode would address its cat as 'O Puss'; 'Short' takes off the last S.
explanation.definitionFit: A composition, especially a numbered musical one, is a work of art.

clue.text: Almost tasteless contents of crap 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a mild Mexican variety

indicators.note: the shortened word becomes the contents of the crap word

parts.note: poo is a childish word for crap

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: bland means tasteless

explanation.surface: A rude complaint that a rubbish pepper has almost no flavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crap' looks like a judgement on the pepper; it supplies the container. 'Almost' and 'contents of' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: The poblano is a large, mild Mexican variety of capsicum, dried as the ancho.

clue.text: Singular pre-erotic recommendation, one preventing reproduction

indicators.note: the pieces before it come ahead of the erotic word

parts.note: an is the singular indefinite article
a tip is a recommendation
I is the Roman numeral for one
racy means risqué, erotic

explanation.surface: Advice to one person about foreplay that stops them conceiving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preventing reproduction' suggests contraception; it means stopping illegal copying.
explanation.definitionFit: Measures against piracy stop people making unlicensed copies of films, music or software.

clue.text: 5 and beans regularly included in Mexican food

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this variety gives its name to a famous sauce

indicators.note: the picked letters are included within the food word

parts.note: a taco is a Mexican folded tortilla

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: Peppers and beans are a regular filling in Mexican dishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes B, A and S from BEANS. The '5 and' reads as a list; 'and' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The tabasco pepper is a variety of capsicum from Mexico used for hot sauce.

clue.text: Stem overwhelming urge for 5

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a hot red variety, often ground

indicators.note: the stem word overwhelms, swallows up, the urge word

parts.note: a cane is a plant stem, as of bamboo or sugar cane
a yen is a longing or urge

explanation.surface: Holding back a strong desire for spicy peppers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stem' looks like a verb meaning to check; it is a plant's stalk.
explanation.definitionFit: Cayenne is a hot red variety of capsicum, usually dried and ground.

clue.text: Aphid firstly, then bee, appear in flower

indicators.note: firstly picks the first letter of aphid

parts.note: bee is how the letter B is spelt out
to loom is to appear, often threateningly

explanation.surface: Garden insects, first a greenfly and then a bee, show up on a blossom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bee' is the name of the letter B.
explanation.definitionFit: Blooming means blossoming, the state of a plant whose buds have opened.

clue.text: 5 misses bit of potato

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a tiny, very hot variety

parts.note: birds is British slang for young women, misses
an eye is the bud on a potato

explanation.surface: A pepper that fails to hit a piece of potato.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misses' looks like a verb; it is plural of miss, young women, 'birds' in British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird's eye pepper is a small and fiery Thai variety of capsicum.

clue.text: Length of flight

definitions.meaning: a coiled hank of yarn or thread, a measured length
a flock of wild geese in flight

explanation.walkthrough: The collective noun for wild geese flying in formation is the second sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a loosely coiled length of wool and a flying formation of geese.

clue.text: To cut disease, eat fish

indicators.note: the eating word cuts into the disease word

parts.note: SARS is a respiratory disease
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: Dietary advice: eat fish to reduce illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To cut' reads as reducing illness, but it signals one piece cutting into the other; the disease is the respiratory illness of 2003.
explanation.definitionFit: These small oily members of the herring family are fish, usually sold in tins.

clue.text: 5 bought by peasant to make turnover

definitions.note: refers to the answer at 5 down; this is a variety from California

indicators.note: turnover tells you to flip the pieces and read them backwards

parts.note: on, as in the drinks are on me, means paid for by
a serf is a feudal peasant

explanation.surface: A farm worker buys peppers to bake into a pastry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turnover' looks like a pastry or trade figure; it reverses ON SERF.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fresno chile is a variety of capsicum named after the Californian city.

clue.text: Gruff adult suppresses rage

indicators.note: the clue words hold the letters pressed down inside them

explanation.surface: A grumpy grown-up keeps his anger in check.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rage' looks like anger; it is a passing craze, all the rage.
explanation.definitionFit: A passing craze, as in all the rage, is a short-lived fashion.

clue.text: Agreement in writing

definitions.meaning: a match or similarity between things

explanation.walkthrough: 'in writing' reads as a contract term, but 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both close similarity between things and the exchange of letters.
